item.title: Viral Video Claiming To Show Woman Mocking Ex-Schoolmate For Working As A Pizza Delivery Executive Is Scripted
item.description: The viral video claiming to show a woman mocking her former schoolmate for becoming a pizza delivery executive is not real. It is a skit created by Rishika Rachana, a content creator from Patna, with her friends acting in the video.

item.title: Viral Photo Showing Rahul Gandhi Confronting PM Modi Inside Parliament Is AI-Generated
item.description: The viral photograph is digitally generated and does not depict a real confrontation between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Rahul Gandhi inside the Parliament.

item.title: Viral Photos Showing Mira Nair, Zohran Mamdani With Jeffrey Epstein Are AI-Generated
item.description: The viral photos claiming to show Mira Nair and Zohran Mamdani with Jeffrey Epstein are AI-generated.

item.title: T20 World Cup: Viral Image Showing Grand Welcome Of Pakistan Team in Sri Lanka Is AI-Generated
item.description: It is an AI-generated image falsely portraying a grand welcome for the Pakistan cricket team in Sri Lanka.

item.title: Ajit Pawar Death: Viral Photo Misidentifies Pilot Killed In Baramati Plane Crash
item.description: The viral photograph being shared online does not show the pilot who was in charge of the charter plane that crashed in Baramati, killing all on board, including Ajit Pawar. The pilot of that flight was Captain Sumit Kapoor, and the verified photographs of him differ from the man shown in the viral image.

item.title: Epstein Files: Viral Images of Donald Trump and Bill Clinton in Compromising Positions Are AI-Generated
item.description: Both viral images allegedly showing Donald Trump and Bill Clinton in compromising positions are digitally fabricated and not part of any verified Epstein file release.

item.title: Indian Media Outlets Wrongly Report That Ex-Indonesian President Visited Tirumala Temple
item.description: The claim that former Indonesian President Joko Widodo visited the Tirumala Tirupati Temple is false. Both his office and the Indonesian Embassy have denied the visit, and visual evidence shows the man in the viral video is someone else. Multiple media outlets appear to have relied on unverified information, contributing to the spread of the incorrect report.

item.title: Fake Notice Falsely Shared As ICC Statement Banning Pakistan Cricket Board For A Year
item.description: The viral media release talking about ICC banning Pakistan for a year is edited.

item.title: Jeffrey Epstein Spotted in Tel Aviv? Viral Photo Is AI-Generated
item.description: The viral image claiming to show Jeffrey Epstein alive in Tel Aviv is AI-generated. There is no credible evidence supporting the claim that Epstein is still alive.
